    COUNT(DISTINCT ca2.agreement_id) AS target_contract_count
FROM party_relation pr
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca1 
    ON pr.source_party_id = ca1.borrower_party_id
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca2 
    ON pr.target_party_id = ca2.borrower_party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY pr.relation_id, pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca1.agreement_id) > 0 
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT ca2.agreement_id) > 0
ORDER BY (COUNT(DISTINCT ca1.agreement_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT ca2.agreement_id)) DESC;

SELECT c.collateral_id, c.asset_label, c.collateral_type
FROM collateral_asset c
WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM collateral_link cl
    WHERE cl.collateral_id = c.collateral_id
      AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  )
ORDER BY c.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 有效保证责任合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(loan_balance.total_principal, 0), 2) AS 自身贷款金额,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) - COALESCE(loan_balance.total_principal, 0), 2) AS 超额担保金额
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) loan_balance ON g.guarantor_party_id = loan_balance.borrower_party_id
WHERE g.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name, loan_balance.total_principal
HAVING SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) > COALESCE(loan_balance.total_principal, 0)
ORDER BY 超额担保金额 DESC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    g.guaranteed_amount AS 保证金额,
    g.status AS 保证状态
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE g.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM loan_drawdown ld
      JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
      JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
      WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = g.guarantor_party_id
        AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
        AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
  )
ORDER BY g.guaranteed_amount DESC, g.guarantor_party_id ASC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ma.obligor_party_id = ld.agreement_id  -- placeholder, will fix below
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE wp.issuer_institution_id = ca.institution_id
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, ma.obligor_party_id
ORDER BY wp.product_name ASC, total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_type AS 担保方式,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.security_id) AS 担保合同笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(so.covered_amount), 2) AS 被担保金额合计
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_type
ORDER BY 被担保金额合计 DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND (cl.collateral_id IS NOT NULL OR gc.commitment_id IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) > 0
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM institution i
JOIN exposure_group eg ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
    AND ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE eg.group_type = 'CONNECTED_CUSTOMER'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id AS 产品编号,
    wp.product_name AS 产品名称,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value), 2) AS 倒挂金额合计,
    COUNT(*) AS 构成倒挂的持仓笔数
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
WHERE phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY 倒挂金额合计 DESC, wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS overdue_principal_total
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ma.obligor_party_id = ld.agreement_id  -- 注意：这里需要关联到借款人，但loan_drawdown没有直接obligor_party_id，需通过credit_agreement
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
  AND ca.borrower_party_id = ma.obligor_party_id
  AND ca.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
  AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'  -- 逾期借据通常为正常状态但存在逾期
GROUP BY wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, phs.lookthrough_depth, phs.carrying_amount, phs.holding_id
ORDER BY phs.lookthrough_depth DESC, phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT 
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS first_lien_valid_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_60_count
FROM collateral_link cl
WHERE cl.lien_priority = 1
  AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY over_60_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    fs.total_assets,
    fs.total_liabilities,
    fs.net_assets,
    fs.annual_revenue
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs 
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY fs.annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.total_liabilities * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 4) AS debt_to_asset_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs 
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY debt_to_asset_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(c.net_capital * 1.0 / c.risk_weighted_assets, 6) AS core_tier1_capital_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot c ON i.institution_id = c.institution_id
WHERE c.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY core_tier1_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(c.net_capital * 1.0 / f.total_assets, 6) AS capital_to_asset_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot c ON i.institution_id = c.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot f ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE c.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND f.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY capital_to_asset_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.annual_revenue, 2) AS annual_revenue,
    ROUND(fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / total_rev.total_revenue, 6) AS revenue_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
JOIN (
    SELECT SUM(annual_revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM financial_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
) total_rev ON 1=1
WHERE fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / total_rev.total_revenue > 0.15
ORDER BY revenue_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS mismatch_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN risk_classification rc ON ca.agreement_id = rc.loan_id
LEFT JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
LEFT JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
LEFT JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
LEFT JOIN credit_facility cf ON ca.facility_id = cf.facility_id
LEFT JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON cf.obligor_party_id = egm.party_id
LEFT JOIN exposure_group eg ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
LEFT JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
LEFT JOIN industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND (
    -- 内部评级与外部评级不一致：这里用风险分类等级与行业风险类别作为代理，实际应比较内部评级字段与外部评级字段
    -- 由于schema中未直接提供内部/外部评级字段，此处以五级分类与行业风险类别不一致作为示例
    (cg.is_nonperforming = 1 AND isec.risk_category = 'NORMAL')
    OR
    (cg.is_nonperforming = 0 AND isec.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT'))
  )
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY mismatch_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ma.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
GROUP BY ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS 开户笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS 本金合计
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 本金合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_count
FROM institution i
JOIN account a ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.annual_interest_rate > 3
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC;

SELECT 
    so.authority_level AS 授权等级,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS 操作员人数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS 员工人数
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE sm.employment_type = 'PERMANENT'
GROUP BY so.authority_level
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY 操作员人数 DESC, 授权等级 ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.unit_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS 笔数
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30'
  AND td.maturity_on <= date('2026-06-30', '+30 days')
GROUP BY ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 笔数 DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount), 2) AS under_provision_total,
    ROUND(fs.net_assets, 2) AS net_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) * 1.0 / fs.net_assets, 6) AS under_provision_ratio
FROM provision_snapshot p
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON p.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE p.required_amount > p.recognized_amount
  AND p.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.net_assets
HAVING SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) > 0
ORDER BY under_provision_ratio DESC, i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT 
    cg.grade_name_zh AS 风险分类名称,
    COUNT(rc.loan_id) AS 借据数量
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE rc.classification_basis = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(rc.loan_id) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY 借据数量 DESC, 风险分类名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    oi.institution_id AS 机构编号,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 不良借据笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(ds.overdue_principal, 0)), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution oi ON ca.institution_id = oi.institution_id
LEFT JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
    AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
GROUP BY oi.institution_id
HAVING ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(ds.overdue_principal, 0)), 2) > 0.5 * (
    SELECT fs.annual_revenue
    FROM financial_snapshot fs
    WHERE fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || oi.institution_id
      AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lb.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance,
    cs.risk_weighted_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(lb.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 6) AS loan_to_rwa_percentage
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lb ON ld.loan_id = lb.loan_id AND lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
LEFT JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.risk_weighted_assets
ORDER BY loan_to_rwa_percentage DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    pi.payment_mode AS 结算方式,
    COUNT(pi.instruction_id) AS 待执行指令数量
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode
HAVING COUNT(pi.instruction_id) > 45
ORDER BY 待执行指令数量 DESC, 结算方式 ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(le.record_id) AS 异常记录数,
    SUM(le.amount_value) AS 异常指标金额,
    cs.net_capital AS 净资本,
    fs.total_assets AS 总资产,
    ROUND(SUM(le.amount_value) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS 占净资本比重
FROM lending_control_event_v3 le
JOIN institution i ON le.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
LEFT JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE le.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital, fs.total_assets
HAVING COUNT(le.record_id) >= 8
ORDER BY 占净资本比重 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT re.record_id) AS 监管报送逾期记录数,
    ROUND(AVG(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS 台账平均金额,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 拨备不足借据数,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount - COALESCE(ps.recognized_amount, 0)), 2) AS 拨备缺口金额
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
LEFT JOIN regulatory_submission_event_v3 re ON i.institution_id = re.institution_id
    AND re.completion_date IS NULL
    AND re.deadline_date < '2026-06-30'
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND (ps.recognized_amount IS NULL OR ps.recognized_amount < ld.disbursed_amount)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT re.record_id) >= 25
ORDER BY 拨备缺口金额 DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.facility_id) AS credit_facility_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN gce.exception_flag = 1 THEN gce.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS abnormal_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(gce.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
LEFT JOIN governance_control_record_v3 gce ON i.institution_id = gce.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN gce.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 END) >= 5
ORDER BY abnormal_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS 关联目标主体数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS 关系种类数,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 非非关联方关系笔数
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
LEFT JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE p.party_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT subject_id 
    FROM related_transaction_record_v3 
    WHERE exception_flag = 1
)
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联目标主体数 DESC, 关系种类数 DESC, 客户名称 ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS card_holder_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ore.amount_value), 2) AS op_risk_exception_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ore.record_id) AS op_risk_valid_record_count
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN organization_unit ou ON i.institution_id = ou.institution_id
LEFT JOIN account a ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id AND a.account_kind = 'CURRENT'
LEFT JOIN payment_card pc ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN operational_risk_event_v3 ore ON i.institution_id = ore.institution_id AND ore.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE ore.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ore.record_id) >= 43
ORDER BY op_risk_exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wp.product_id) AS on_sale_product_count,
    ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount), 2) AS total_actual_raise,
    COUNT(pce.record_id) AS product_conduct_record_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pce.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN wealth_product wp ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id AND wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
LEFT JOIN product_conduct_event_v3 pce ON i.institution_id = pce.institution_id AND pce.exception_flag = 1
WHERE i.institution_id IN (
    SELECT institution_id
    FROM product_conduct_event_v3
    WHERE exception_flag = 1
    GROUP BY institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(record_id) >= 2
)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_actual_raise DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS asset_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ma.issued_amount), 2) AS total_issued_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT co.record_id) AS custody_active_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN co.exception_flag = 1 THEN co.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS exception_amount
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN institution i ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN custody_operation_event_v3 co ON co.institution_id = i.institution_id
    AND co.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
    AND co.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN co.exception_flag = 1 THEN co.record_id END) >= 2
ORDER BY total_issued_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;
